title: INITIATION: FIRST CONTACT
briefing: Rogue satellite debris detected entering low Earth trajectory. Deploy mobile launch pad, calibrate Viper-I elevation, and eliminate the target.

title: MOJAVE CROSSWINDS
briefing: Thermal desert updrafts are pushing westbound. Factor in +2.5 m/s wind deflection to strike the orbital core.

title: SHIELDED OUTPOST
briefing: Hostile reconnaissance beacon deployed an active energy forcefield. Fire a sustained salvo or high-explosive round to shatter the barrier.

title: AERIAL SKYWATCHER
briefing: Autonomous stealth drone executing sinusoidal patrol over the dune ridge. Lead your target along its flight vector.

title: LONG-RANGE CORRIDOR
briefing: Target is anchored 65 meters out behind a ridge. Maximize launch force and set high 65-degree parabolic arc.

title: DESERT APEX: DREADNOUGHT
briefing: COMMAND ALERT: Heavy orbital cruiser hovering at coordinates. Massive armor plating. Use Titan-Heavy to punch through its hull.

title: COASTAL INSERTION
briefing: Relocated to Pacific bluffs. Strong onshore marine breeze detected. Calibrate yaw counter-steering.

title: GALE FORCE RUN
briefing: Pacific storm front incoming. Wind exceeding 8.0 m/s. Precision rocket or heavy mass required to prevent drift.

title: HOVERING DRONE SWARM
briefing: Fast maritime drone evading radar. Time your launch window during the crest of its hover wave.

title: CLIFFSIDE BUNKER
briefing: Energy shield generator locked inside sea cove. Low angle required to skip under the sea mist ceiling.

title: OCEAN SKYWAY
briefing: High altitude satellite repeater. Launch Mach-X with max velocity to reach apex before fuel burnout.

title: LEVIATHAN FLAGSHIP
briefing: CHAPTER 2 BOSS: Naval Dreadnought flagship deploying coastal jamming. Direct impact to the command bridge required.

title: SUB-ZERO PERMAFROST
briefing: Station Svalbard defense grid. Freezing air density increases aerodynamic drag. Increase thrust to compensate.

title: BLIZZARD VOLLEY
briefing: Blinding snowstorm. Trajectory visibility degraded. Rely on HUD flight telemetry and digital predictor line.

title: ARCTIC FALCON
briefing: High-speed surveillance drone scouting polar silos. Extreme lateral gusts. Fire Ion-Precision.

title: GLACIER BASTION
briefing: Reinforced cryo-shield anchored to glacial ice shelf. Double impact mandatory to breach reactor core.

title: POLAR HIGHWAY
briefing: Satellite debris skipping across the upper stratosphere. High 72-degree pitch angle with maximum thrust.

title: FROSTPEAK COLOSSUS
briefing: CHAPTER 3 BOSS: Heavy Arctic Assault Fortress with rotating ice-defense shields. Obliterate its structural pylons.

title: NEO-METROPOLIS SKYLINE
briefing: Urban orbital defense corridor. Navigate rocket trajectory between skyscraper air corridors.

title: NEON DOWNTOWN
briefing: Hostile drone skimming rooftops. Calculate altitude to clear urban interference.

title: CORP-TOWER FORCEFIELD
briefing: Corporate black-site bunker protected by dual harmonic shielding. Titan-Heavy recommended.

title: HIGH-OCTANE CHASE
briefing: Fast courier drone descending through smog layer. Tight timing window.

title: ORBITAL UPLINK NODE
briefing: Long range satellite uplink dish. Clear the antenna cluster for a direct bullseye.

title: NEO-DREADNOUGHT TITAN
briefing: CHAPTER 4 BOSS: Rogue military gunship hovering over the central city spire. Unleash maximum firepower.

title: LUNAR ALPHA INSERTION
briefing: Welcome to Moon Base Alpha. Gravity is 1.62 m/s² (1/6th Earth). ZERO atmospheric drag. Trajectories travel 4x further!

title: CRATER PERIMETER
briefing: Target positioned along the Shackleton crater rim. Use low force setting—moon gravity means minimal drop.

title: ORBITAL VACUUM DRONE
briefing: Lunar reconnaissance drone utilizing reaction control thrusters. Pure Newtonian ballistics required.

title: DEEP SPACE HORIZON
briefing: Extreme distance target over 90 meters out across the lunar regolith plain. High angle precision trajectory.

title: LUNAR RELAY DEFENSE
briefing: Hostile relay station shielding deep-space transmitter. Break shield then eliminate base.

title: FINAL ORBITAL CRISIS: APEX MOTHER SHIP
briefing: GRAND CAMPAIGN FINALE: The mothership is descending to disrupt lunar orbital defense. Destroy all defensive barriers and detonate its reactor core!
